name: The Hundred
shortDescription: A breath-driven warm-up that engages the abdominals while pumping the arms and stabilizing the ribcage.
benefits: Improves lung capacity and steady core support through intentional breath pacing.
modifications: Keep the head on the mat and legs lower to reduce cervical strain and core load.
Perform single-leg pumps or supported heel taps if full leg extension is too intense.
progressions: Extend the legs higher while keeping the pelvis stable.
Increase arm speed slightly once breath coordination is steady.

name: Roll Up
shortDescription: Sequential spinal articulation from supine to seated that builds core strength while lengthening the back.
benefits: Builds deep abdominal control while teaching safe spinal articulation.
modifications: Bend the knees and use the arms to support the spine during the roll-up.
Start with a tabletop prep variation if hamstring flexibility is limited.
progressions: Perform with straight legs and less use of the arms.
Lift the arms overhead to increase the challenge once the spine is stable.

name: Roll Over
shortDescription: Controlled inversion and spine mobility exercise that opens the back line and stretches the hamstrings.
benefits: Enhances back flexibility and helps stretch the posterior chain.

name: Rolling Like a Ball
shortDescription: Rounded rolling movement that massages the spine, challenges balance, and coordinates breath with motion.
benefits: Develops balance, spine mobility, and circular movement control.

name: Spine Stretch Forward
shortDescription: Seated forward stretch with dynamic spinal flexion and hamstring length, emphasizing posture and ribcage control.
benefits: Promotes spinal flexion with hamstring length and posture awareness.

name: Roll Down
shortDescription: Sequential spinal articulation from standing to mat that mobilizes the spine and lengthens the back.
benefits: Improves segmental spine mobility while reinforcing deep abdominal support.
modifications: Bend the knees slightly and move slower if hamstring flexibility is limited.
Keep the arms long and the shoulders relaxed away from the ears.
progressions: Work toward a slower, fully articulated roll-down with longer inhalations between each segment.
Add a small arm reach forward at the bottom to increase spinal length and control.

name: Teaser
shortDescription: Classic V-shape lift demanding core precision, hip flexor coordination, and a long, supported spine.
benefits: Strengthens the full core and challenges coordination in a balanced lift.

name: Saw
shortDescription: Seated rotation with spinal flexion that stretches the hamstrings and obliques while maintaining a stable pelvis.
benefits: Improves rotational mobility and encourages a long, stable spine.

name: Corkscrew
shortDescription: Supine hip circle exercise for lower abdominal control and gentle spinal articulation through rotation.
benefits: Targets lower abdominal support and gentle hip mobility.

name: Jackknife
shortDescription: Advanced bridge-to-inversion that articulates the spine and hips while challenging control and shoulder stability.
benefits: Builds control through inverted spine articulation and hip lift.

name: Neck Pull
shortDescription: Torso lift from supine using abdominal strength to articulate the spine while maintaining neck length.
benefits: Supports core-driven upper spinal articulation without neck strain.

name: Spine Twist
shortDescription: Seated rotational mobility movement that maintains pelvic stability while opening the torso and shoulders.
benefits: Increases seated spine rotation while maintaining pelvic stability.

name: Side Bend
shortDescription: Lateral flexion exercise that stretches the side body and strengthens the obliques with a long torso line.
benefits: Lengthens the side body and strengthens lateral core support.

name: Boomerang
shortDescription: Dynamic rolling balance combining twist, hip lift and coordination in a flowing V-sit shape.
benefits: Boosts coordination, balance, and dynamic postural control.

name: Swan Dive
shortDescription: Prone extension that lifts the chest and legs with fluid spine movement and length through the back.
focus: Back extension and posterior chain strengthening.
benefits: Strengthens the back line and encourages fluid extension.

name: Swimming
shortDescription: Prone alternate arm and leg lifts that tone the posterior chain and encourage coordinated breath.
benefits: Tones the posterior chain and improves breath-synchronized movement.

name: Shoulder Bridge
shortDescription: Pelvic articulation exercise that mobilizes the spine and engages the hamstrings from a supported shoulder base.
benefits: Mobilizes the spine and activates glutes with controlled lifting.

name: Leg Pull Front
shortDescription: Plank-based leg lift that strengthens the core, glutes and shoulders while promoting full-body alignment.
benefits: Challenges full-body alignment and shoulder-core integration.

name: Leg Pull Back
shortDescription: Prone leg lift movement that trains lower back support, glute control and stable shoulder placement.
benefits: Reinforces lower back support and glute engagement in prone extension.

name: Side Kick Series
shortDescription: Side-lying leg sequence focusing on hip stability, precise control, and long supporting posture.
benefits: Sharpens hip stability and precise leg control in side-lying work.

name: Seal
shortDescription: Playful rounded rolling exercise that combines balance, breath, and spinal rounding with rhythmic clapping.
benefits: Builds coordination and spine articulation through playful rolling.

name: Crab
shortDescription: Supine roll with legs overhead that challenges spinal articulation, shoulder support, and breath rhythm.
benefits: Enhances spinal mobility with shoulder stability in a rolling balance.

name: Control Balance
shortDescription: Advanced inversion that tests balance, hip control, and maintaining a long spine in a lifted position.
benefits: Tests balance and lower back strength in a lifted inversion.

name: Scissors
shortDescription: Supine alternating leg stretch that opens the hamstrings while preserving a stable trunk and pelvis.
benefits: Strengthens abdominal support while deepening hamstring stretch.

name: Bicycle
shortDescription: Alternating supine leg cycling that strengthens the core and promotes controlled spinal stability.
benefits: Develops core endurance and controlled lower-body rotation.

name: One Leg Circle
shortDescription: Single-leg hip circle from supine that develops pelvic stability and hip joint mobility.
benefits: Improves hip mobility while maintaining a stable torso and pelvis.

name: Single Leg Stretch
shortDescription: Alternating knee draw-ins that coordinate breath with abdominal engagement and hip stability.
focus: Core coordination and hip flexor control.
benefits: Builds coordination between breath, core, and leg movement.

name: Double Leg Stretch
shortDescription: Full-body extension requiring precise timing, core support, and smooth breath coordination.
benefits: Encourages full-body length and coordinated abdominal support.

name: Open Leg Rocker
shortDescription: Rolling balance exercise with open legs that challenges core control, spine articulation, and lengthening.
benefits: Tests balance, core strength, and spine articulation in rolling.

name: Hip Circles
shortDescription: Controlled hip rotation movement that mobilizes the pelvis while engaging the core for stability.
benefits: Mobilizes the hips while reinforcing core stability.

name: One Leg Kick
shortDescription: Prone leg kick series that strengthens the hamstrings and chest while keeping the spine long and shoulders grounded.
focus: Posterior chain strength and shoulder stability.
benefits: Strengthens hamstrings and shoulders in a controlled prone position.

name: Double Leg Kick
shortDescription: Prone chest lift with leg kicks, blending spinal extension with shoulder stability and rhythmic breath.
benefits: Combines back extension with upper-body stability and rhythm.

name: Knee Stretch
shortDescription: Kneeling knee circles that enhance pelvic stability, leg control, and mindful abdominal engagement.
benefits: Fortifies pelvic stability and smooth leg coordination in kneeling.

name: Pelvic Curl
shortDescription: Articulated bridge movement that mobilizes the spine, activates the glutes, and lengthens the back body.
benefits: Articulates the spine while activating glutes and posterior chain.

name: Breaststroke
shortDescription: Prone arm and leg extension performed with gentle torso lift and steady breath rhythm.
focus: Posterior chain extension and breath flow.
benefits: Gentle extension that connects breath with posterior chain flow.

name: Push Up
shortDescription: Dynamic core and upper-body exercise performed from a plank position with precise shoulder stacking.
focus: Shoulder stability, core endurance, and upper-body control.
benefits: Strengthens the arms, shoulders, and abdominals while reinforcing a long spine.
modifications: Keep the knees on the mat and perform the movement from a modified plank if full arm support is too intense.
Reduce the range of motion and keep the elbows closer to the rib cage to protect the shoulders.
progressions: Move to a full mat push-up with slower lowering and lifting once shoulder stability improves.
Add a controlled leg lift or alternating arm reach for a greater core challenge.

name: Footwork
shortDescription: Reformer leg pressing sequence that builds coordinated leg strength and alignment through the carriage.
benefits: Improves lower-body coordination, knee tracking, and pelvic stability.
modifications: Use lighter springs or a smaller range of motion to reduce knee strain.
Keep the heels down and focus on smooth pelvic stability throughout the press.
progressions: Increase spring tension gradually as alignment and control improve.
Explore single-leg variations on the carriage after the basic series feels stable.

name: Elephant
shortDescription: Reformer forward fold with hip hinge that mobilizes the hamstrings and challenges core control.
benefits: Enhances spinal length and shoulder stability while strengthening the posterior chain.

name: Mermaid
shortDescription: Side-body stretch on the chair that opens the ribcage and improves lateral mobility.
benefits: Increases flexibility in the waistline and creates more freedom in the upper body.
modifications: Keep the pelvis stable and work with a smaller reach if the ribcage or low back is sensitive.
Use the hand on the chair for support to avoid collapsing into the side body.
progressions: Lift the top arm higher and deepen the side bend once the base is stable.
Add a gentle twist toward the ceiling while keeping the spine long.

name: Push Up on Chair
shortDescription: Chair exercise that builds upper-body strength and balance with controlled shoulder loading.
benefits: Improves upper body strength and proprioception in a compact chair setting.
modifications: Use a lower spring tension or keep the hands on a stable surface if the chair feels unstable.
Limit range of motion and keep the elbows soft to protect the shoulders.
progressions: Increase the load gradually by pressing more fully through the arms with a steady torso.
Add a small leg lift or abdominal reach once shoulder control is secure.

name: Teaser on Chair
shortDescription: Chair-based teaser variation that challenges core control and balance with a seated lift.
benefits: Strengthens the abdominals while reinforcing pelvic stability and coordination.
modifications: Keep the knees bent and lift only as far as comfortable.
Use the hands on the chair for extra balance while building core support.
progressions: Extend the legs further and lengthen the spine as abdominal control improves.
Work toward a full teaser shape with a slow, supported lowering phase.

name: Push Through
shortDescription: Cadillac exercise that presses the body over the bar, strengthening the back and postural stability.
benefits: Builds spinal articulation and controlled upper-body power.

name: Magic Circle Press
shortDescription: Mat-based prop exercise that challenges inner thigh and upper body engagement using the circle.
focus: Inner thigh strength and upper body compression.
benefits: Improves muscle tone and precision through added resistance.

name: Short Spine Massage
shortDescription: Reformer spinal articulation with leg circles that decompresses the spine and stretches the hamstrings.
benefits: Encourages deep spinal flexion and improves overall carriage control.
modifications: Keep the legs lower and move slowly through the circle while maintaining breath.
Stop before full inversion if the shoulders or low back feel compromised.
progressions: Use a slightly larger leg circle once spinal control is strong.
Add small pulsing movements for deeper pelvic articulation.

name: Knee Stretch Series
shortDescription: Reformer series performed in kneeling position that improves pelvic stability and leg alignment.
focus: Pelvic stability and posterior chain control.
benefits: Strengthens the core, glutes, and leg stabilizers in a controlled kneeling posture.
modifications: Use a softer spring setting to reduce hip and knee pressure.
Keep the hips square and limit the range of motion if the knees feel irritated.
progressions: Increase the carriage range gradually while keeping the trunk stable.
Move into the back extension variation on the same springs for added challenge.

name: Long Box Series
shortDescription: Reformer flow on the long box that targets upper body strength and back extension with carriage coordination.
focus: Upper body strength and spinal support.
benefits: Builds back extensors, shoulder stability, and proprioception on the carriage.
modifications: Use lighter springs and keep the head in line with the spine during reach.
Perform smaller range of motion on the arm exercises if the shoulders are sensitive.
progressions: Add longer arms or leg lifts once the back support is comfortable.
Increase the spring tension slightly to develop more strength through the carriage.

name: Coordination
shortDescription: A flowing Reformer sequence that combines footwork, arm coordination, and breathing for smooth carriage control.
focus: Timing, core support, and breath coordination.
benefits: Improves fluidity on the carriage while reinforcing stable alignment and respiration.
modifications: Use a lighter spring and smaller arm movements if rhythm is difficult.
Pause between each leg and arm transition to maintain a stable torso.
progressions: Gradually deepen each leg extension and arm movement while keeping the carriage smooth.
Add a slower inhalation/exhalation rhythm to accentuate control.

name: Tendon Stretch
shortDescription: Reformer exercise balancing an inverted foot position with shoulder stability and leg strength.
focus: Leg tendon stretch and shoulder support.
benefits: Builds balance, hamstring length, and coordinated upper body control.
modifications: Keep the legs lower and the hips stable if the hamstrings feel tight.
Use lighter springs and a smaller ankle range to keep the shoulders supported.
progressions: Work toward a fuller ankle stretch with a steady spine and controlled shoulder position.
Lengthen the hold once balance and comfort improve.

name: Long Spine Massage
shortDescription: Reformer spinal articulation flow that lifts the hips and elongates the spine while the feet move in a circular path.
benefits: Enhances back flexibility and promotes smooth articulation of the pelvis and spine.
modifications: Keep the legs lower and less inverted if the hamstrings or back feel sensitive.
Move slowly through the circle and maintain steady breathing.
progressions: Increase the circle height once spinal control is secure.
Add a gentle hip lift articulation with each breath for deeper mobilization.

name: Stomach Massage (Round Back)
shortDescription: Classic Reformer series that strengthens the core and improves carriage control with a rounded spine.
focus: Core stability and articulated spine control.
benefits: Develops abdominal support, breath coordination, and smooth leg carriage movement.
modifications: Use lighter springs and keep a short range of motion if the abdominals feel sensitive.
Slow the leg movements and focus on ribcage stabilization through the entire sequence.
progressions: Increase the range of movement and work toward a longer carriage cycle with controlled breath.
Hold the legs slightly higher or use a lower tension spring for a deeper challenge.

name: Stomach Massage (Flat Back)
shortDescription: Reformer variation emphasizing a flat back for abdominal strength and pelvic stability.
focus: Core endurance and neutral spine support.
benefits: Builds strength in the deep abdominals while promoting a stable, supported torso.
modifications: Shorten the range of motion and keep the head relaxed to avoid neck strain.
Use a softer spring setting and pause at each leg change to reinforce stability.
progressions: Increase the carriage range and coordinate with breathing for smoother transitions.
Try longer leg extensions once the lower abs feel secure and supported.

name: Roll Down Bar
shortDescription: Cadillac exercise that focuses on spinal articulation while moving the torso over the bar in a controlled roll-down.
benefits: Improves deep core control and encourages smooth spinal mobility.
modifications: Start with a smaller range and keep the shoulders relaxed away from the ears.
Use a softer spring or lighter resistance if the upper back feels tight.
progressions: Increase the roll-down depth with a slower cadence.
Add arm reach variations while maintaining spinal length and control.

name: Arm Springs
shortDescription: Cadillac upper-body sequence using springs to build shoulder mobility and control.
benefits: Improves controlled arm movement and upper-body coordination through spring resistance.
modifications: Use lighter springs and keep the elbows slightly bent to reduce strain.
Work with smaller arm arcs until the shoulders feel stable.
progressions: Increase the range of motion and add slower transitions for more shoulder control.
Experiment with higher spring tension once the movement feels secure.

name: Leg Springs
shortDescription: Cadillac leg spring series that strengthens the legs while maintaining pelvic stability.
benefits: Builds coordinated lower-body control with spring resistance and stable pelvis alignment.
modifications: Use lighter spring tension and keep the movement slow if the hips feel sensitive.
Keep the legs in a smaller range of motion and keep the spine supported.
progressions: Increase the spring tension gradually as control improves.
Try longer leg circles or lifts with a steady pelvis.

name: Pilates Ring Squeeze
shortDescription: Prop-based inner thigh and upper body exercise using the circle to create controlled resistance.
focus: Inner thigh strength and upper body stability.
benefits: Adds accessible resistance for improved muscle engagement and precision.
modifications: Use a lighter squeeze and focus on keeping the pelvis stable.
Hold the ring lightly if wrist or shoulder tension is present.
progressions: Increase the squeeze resistance as control improves.
Combine the ring squeeze with longer arm movements for an added challenge.

name: Ball Roll
shortDescription: Supine ball exercise that massages the spine and challenges balance while strengthening the core.
benefits: Enhances proprioception, coordination, and controlled movement with a small Pilates ball.
modifications: Use a smaller ball and keep the legs closer to the body for greater support.
Move more slowly through each roll to maintain stability.
progressions: Roll with longer legs or a larger ball once control improves.
Add a small pause at the top of each roll to engage the deep core.

name: Resistance Band Arm Series
shortDescription: Standing or seated band sequence that strengthens the arms and shoulders with portable resistance.
focus: Upper body strength and scapular stability.
benefits: Improves shoulder control and arm endurance using easy-to-use prop resistance.
modifications: Use lighter band tension and keep the movements small if the shoulders are sensitive.
Perform the series seated for extra stability.
progressions: Increase band tension or add longer reaches as control improves.
Combine the band series with core bracing for a full-body challenge.
